text:
Maya S: FYI — FinReg Corp (enterprise POC) just sent a 'must-have' list before we start. They want a data residency confirmation, a data flow diagram that shows where prompts/outputs/logs go, full list of subprocessors that touch customer data, KMS/HSM details, and whether we persist tokens. Need to reply with what we can provide by EOD tomorrow.
Priya K: We can provide a high-level data flow diagram and our subprocessor list. I can pull the SIG/CAIQ snapshot. Quick question: do they want every vendor we use (monitoring/analytics) or only vendors that can access plaintext prompts/outputs?
Maya S: They said "any subprocessors that touch customer data or metadata (including monitoring/observability)." So include monitoring, error-tracking, and logs providers.
Alex M: For Hosted EU POC mode — processing and storage can be pinned to eu-west-1. We do not replicate customer prompts outside the selected region for EU-hosted deployments. Runtime notes: KV cache is in-memory on GPU nodes (ephemeral). We do not write prompt content to disk unless logging is enabled.
Sam R: Technical clarifications: 1) By default we do not persist prompts to long-term storage. 2) Audit/logging (if enabled) writes to object storage in the same region as the deployment. 3) We support envelope encryption with AWS KMS for hosted. Private deployments can use customer-managed KMS or HSM. 4) Default log retention is 30 days for POC, configurable on contracts.
Daniel L: Subprocessors list we can share: AWS (compute/S3), Datadog (metrics/traces), Sentry (errors), Sumo Logic (if still used), Segment (telemetry) — I'll confirm exact vendors and legal-approved descriptions. We should also offer the SOC 2 summary and our DPA template.
Maya S: They also asked for an annotated data flow (PNG/SVG) and a CSV of subprocessors + region per vendor. Can we produce a redacted diagram for POC now and a full set after contract?
Tom S: Yes. For POC we typically send a redacted diagram that highlights: ingress (customer prompts) -> API edge (regional) -> runtime GPU node (in-region) -> in-memory KV cache -> model compute -> ephemeral output -> optional audit log -> object store (in-region). I'll draft a short diagram and a one-pager describing each step. I can also include the default encryption callouts.
Priya K: I'll attach the SIG/CAIQ snapshot and the subprocessor CSV link in this thread (will share internal S3 link). We can't publish keys or internal hostnames in the public doc, but we can include KMS key types, regions, and whether the customer can bring their own key.
Maya S: Pricing/POC ask — they want reserved capacity for a 2-week POC with up to 200k tokens/day. Can sales offer a trial credit or discounted reserved block? Need to include any constraints in the response to security (like no long-term logs persisted).
Tom S: Standard POC offer: free trial credits up to 7 days. For extended POCs we do a short-term reserved pool at a discounted rate — I can put numbers but need approval. I'll call out that by default we do not persist prompts; enabling audit logs requires explicit opt-in and is billable.
Alex M: One more infra detail: metrics and traces flow to Datadog (hosted), but for EU-hosted POC we can route metrics to an EU Datadog endpoint. Error payloads captured by Sentry are redacted by default; stack traces don't include user prompt content unless customer enables developer-level debug mode.
Priya K: Action items: 1) I'll export the current SIG/CAIQ snapshot and verified subprocessor list and drop links here. 2) Alex/Sam to confirm exact region endpoints and the audit-log opt-in toggle name. 3) Legal (Daniel) to prepare a DPA + SOC2 blurb. 4) Tom to assemble redacted dataflow diagram and one-pager by EOD.
Daniel L: I'll prepare the DPA excerpt and confirm vendor list. Note: we should mark Sentry/Datadog as not having direct access to customer plaintext unless logs are explicitly enabled.
deploy-bot: Deployment: redacted-dataflow-diagram.png uploaded to internal S3 (link: https://internal.s3.redwood/reports/redacted-dataflow-diagram.png)
Maya S: Great — I'll relay this to FinReg and ask if they want the SOC2 attestation and CAIQ spreadsheet now or after the POC scoping call. Thanks everyone.
